blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Santiniketan in Birbhum district was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in September 2023, highlighting its unique open-air education model and cultural legacy.
Sundarbans National Park achieved UNESCO Natural World Heritage status in 1987 for hosting the world's largest contiguous mangrove ecosystem and Royal Bengal Tigers.
Darjeeling Himalayan Railway (DHR), constructed between 1879 and 1881, was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1999 as an outstanding mountain railway engineering feat.
Bishnupur in Bankura district is renowned for its 17th and 18th-century terracotta temples built under the patronage of the Malla rulers.
Hazarduari Palace in Murshidabad, designed by Colonel Duncan Macleod in 1837, features 1,000 doors (900 real and 100 decorative/false doors).
Santiniketan was recognized as India's 41st UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2023—frequently asked in current affairs and static GK.
Victoria Memorial Kolkata was designed by Sir William Emerson in the Indo-Saracenic revivalist style using white Makrana marble.
Bishnupur terracotta temples were built primarily using local laterite soil and brick architecture under Malla King Veer Hambir and his successors.

cells: [EXAM TIP] Indian Museum in Kolkata (1814) is the oldest and largest museum in India. Shantiniketan was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2023. Both are asked in WB Police exams.
